correctness.rationale: Euclid parametrization m>n coprime opposite parity gives odd-square leg m²-n²=(m-n)(m+n) with coprime odd factors, uniquely u²,v²; even-square 2mn forces {m,n}={2u²,v²} with v odd and (u,v)=1. Their heights are (u⁴+v⁴)/2 and 4u⁴+v⁴. Primitive odd-odd density 2/pi² and v-odd density 4/pi² follow odd-divisor Möbius inversion; symmetric quartic-region areas both sqrt(2)G/2 after diagonal restriction/rescaling; boundary error O(X^(1/4)log X). Fermat fourth-power descent forbids both legs square. Independent direct Euclid and quartic counts agree at X=100:(1,3), 1000:(3,8), 10000:(13,27), 1000000:(132,269). Finite cross-check does not establish infinity.
